description: Ordinary notes whose preferences pull against the protein band and the time limit

contextNotes.heading: How the cut is going
contextNotes.body: Down about 2 kg since March. Evenings are the hard part: I get home hungry and want a big bowl of something starchy, and lately I would rather have more rice or couscous and less meat on the plate.

contextNotes.heading: Taste
contextNotes.body: Chickpeas feel heavy lately. Slow braises are my favourite thing to eat, the longer the better. Preserved lemon and harissa are always welcome.
